provenance.invariant: The declined-VTIMEZONE fallback: when no VTIMEZONE can be produced for the zone, a recurring series falls back to UTC anchoring — DTSTART/DTEND/EXDATE all in the Z form, no dangling TZID. Synthetic input (agenda always sends valid IANA ids); it pins the fallback contract itself.
